# Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus

## SYNOPSIS

Gets the running passive proxy sessions.

## SYNTAX

```
Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus [[-Name] <string>] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus cmdlet writes the passive proxy sessions running in this runspace, or the one named in -Name: each with its name, when it started, its Listener (the address and port the server connects to), and the configuration the server last pushed. It reads only the runspace's own sessions and sends nothing. Start-ZbxPassiveProxy starts a session and Stop-ZbxPassiveProxy ends it.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: List the running passive proxy sessions

```powershell
Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus | Select-Object Name, Started
```

Every passive proxy session of this runspace.

### Example 2: Find the port a passive proxy listens on

```powershell
(Get-ZbxPassiveProxyStatus -Name 'dmz-proxy').Listener.LocalEndPoint
```

Listener.LocalEndPoint is the address and port to give the proxy object (New-ZbxProxy -Address -Port).

## PARAMETERS

### -Name

The session's name (the -Name it was started with); every running passive-proxy session when omitted.

## OUTPUTS

- `ZabbixPassiveProxySession`: Represents a passive proxy's listener kept running as a session: the server comes to it.
